checks.title: Entry-timing difference is declared
checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (224 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: Checklist paired_population is green: '4848 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them', and the arena header states 'all arms share identical detections'.
findings.problem: The per-arm open-trade breakdown in that same check lists only six arms (control, hold-12h, placebo, sl-5pct, tp-7pct, vol-4x) — entry-8pct is absent from the paired accounting entirely. And the scored samples are not identical: control screen_n=1560, vol-4x screen_n=874, entry-8pct screen_n=498. Seeing the same detections is not the same as being scored on the same trades; entry-8pct's screen_wr=51.807 and screen_ev=-0.035 rest on under a third of control's sample, so the check is green for a weaker property than the one it asserts.

Both arms report a zero win-rate delta against a control whose screen_wr=50.128, while their own screen_wr values are 51.807 and 51.487 respectively. Either the delta field is not being computed for these arms or it is being computed against something other than control — the same field is populated for hold-12h (3.27pp), sl-5pct (5.26pp) and tp-7pct (-3.41pp). A 0.0pp reads as 'no effect' when the underlying numbers say otherwise; that is a display that can silently retire or ignore an arm.

findings.claim: entry_granularity_declared: 'Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel'.
findings.problem: That reasoning holds only for arms whose changed parameter is unrelated to the biased quantity. The kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (224 matched setups), and entry-8pct's single changed parameter is pump_pct=8.0 — a threshold on exactly the quantity that is measured too large. Its admitted population therefore includes events whose true pump is below its own threshold, and the bias does not cancel between it and control the way a shared-kernel argument assumes. The declared limitation is attached but its stated scope is wrong for this arm.

findings.claim: MECHANISM CLASSES: 'one per running arm — diversity is enforced in code'.
findings.problem: Among the seven arms marked running/confirm, control and entry-8pct are both class=entry_trigger, and placebo and vol-4x are both class=liquidity_filter. Whatever the code enforces, it is not one class per running arm; the constraint as stated is not established by the arena contents. It also means control's class label (entry_trigger, changed={}) is doing no work, so the diversity count is inflated by two non-arms.

findings.claim: backfill_cannot_promote is green: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote — 0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen'.
findings.problem: Zero surfaced arms means the guard has never been exercised, so the green establishes only that nothing has been promoted at all, not that a backfill-only promotion would be refused. Meanwhile every screen_wr/screen_ev number in the arena (screen_n around 1560 for control, sl-5pct, placebo, tp-7pct) comes from a pool of 4764 backfill events against 84 live events, and live_n per arm ranges from 5 to 26 against a confirm plan of n=600. The check's pass condition is vacuous on the current data.

findings.claim: arms_running is green with detail '5 running: tp-7pct, hold-12h, entry-8pct, sl-5pct, vol-4x'.
findings.problem: The arena lists seven arms in state running/confirm — the five named plus control and placebo. A count that silently omits the two arms every verdict is measured against is exactly the metadata-over-evidence pattern the methodology names (firstred-1h). Separately, entry-8pct carries the status 'confirm' with live_n=5 and declined=79, i.e. a confirm-stage label on an arm that has almost no live tape and rejects most of the shared stream; the status word is not backed by the sample behind it.
